# Dseams.jl

> Dseams is the Julia front for the d-SEAMS engine: CHILL+, primitive rings, ice and clathrate cages, Steinhardt order parameters and shell symmetry on LAMMPS trajectories.

The package is `Dseams`. It calls `libseams_lang`, the C ABI of the d-SEAMS engine, through `ccall`, and gets the library from `libseams_jll` or from a local build named by `SEAMS_LANG_LIB`. Julia 1.10 or newer. The engine, its C API and its documentation site are in d-SEAMS/seams-core; this repository holds only Julia code. Each manual link below is a page of the Documenter site at https://julia.dseams.info/, and the source markdown of each page is under `docs/src` in the repository. Contributor instructions are in the contributing guide at the repository root, next to README.md.

## Manual

- [Dseams](https://julia.dseams.info/): What Dseams computes, how it relates to Seams, how the engine library is found, and the example data.
- [Getting started](https://julia.dseams.info/getting-started/): Build the engine, configure Dseams, and run a smoke test.
- [Examples](https://julia.dseams.info/examples/): The scripts in `examples/`, which the tests run, with the census line each prints.
- [API](https://julia.dseams.info/api/): Docstrings of every exported function, each with a doctest.
- [Julia chapter of the book](https://docs.dseams.info/stable/julia.html): The Julia front in the d-SEAMS documentation.
- [Video walk-through](https://odysee.com/dseams-julia:ec237bd28c57b7bdfa2996ccc420c16d9799176f): A video walk-through of the Julia package.

## Project

- [README](https://github.com/d-SEAMS/Dseams.jl/blob/main/README.md): Quick start, a local engine build, layout, development and release order.
- [Repository root](https://github.com/d-SEAMS/Dseams.jl): The contributing guide: layout, test commands, how seams-core and libseams_jll are pinned and found, commit and changelog conventions.
- [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/d-SEAMS/Dseams.jl/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): Changes by release, Keep a Changelog format.
- [Seams](https://github.com/d-SEAMS/Dseams.jl/tree/main/lib/Seams): Unregistered example package over the stable `libseams` C API.

## Engine

- [seams-core](https://github.com/d-SEAMS/seams-core): The C++ engine, the C API (`include/seams.h`), the C ABI for language fronts (`bindings/cxx/seams_lang.h`), and the `libseams_jll` Yggdrasil recipe.
- [d-SEAMS documentation](https://docs.dseams.info): Engine manual, analysis methods, CLI and tutorials.

## Other language fronts

- [PydSEAMSlib](https://github.com/d-SEAMS/PydSEAMSlib): Python.
- [dseams-r](https://github.com/d-SEAMS/dseams-r): R.
- [dseams-rs](https://github.com/d-SEAMS/dseams-rs): Rust.
- [dseams-fortran](https://github.com/d-SEAMS/dseams-fortran): Fortran (fpm).
- [yodaStruct](https://github.com/d-SEAMS/yodaStruct): Lua and Fennel.
